name: Gobbiebag Voucher I
description: Presented to the Goblin Emporium to expand inventory capacity by 10 slots.

name: Guard Uniform
description: Authentic patrol uniform. Guards see through it faster than civilians do.

name: Civilian Clothes
description: Unremarkable street clothes. Passes inspection from most NPCs except civilians who know the area.

name: Merchant Coat
description: A merchant's long coat with hidden pockets. Accepted by market NPCs; arouses suspicion from guards.

name: Mikazuki
description: A legendary katana named for its crescent moon blade, said to grant its wielder swiftness in combat.

name: Juzumaru
description: A legendary katana whispered to possess a profound, ancient spirit, said to empower its wielder with unparalleled precision.

name: Onimaru
description: A legendary katana, said to be imbued with the essence of a vengeful spirit, granting its wielder supernatural speed and precision.

name: Ōdenta
description: A legendary katana, one of the Five Great Swords of Japan, imbued with the spirit of a fierce guardian.

name: Dōjigiri
description: One of the Five Great Swords of legend, said to have slain the oni Shuten Dōji. Its edge hums with an ancient, formidable power.

name: Beestinger
description: A slender dagger crafted to resemble a giant bee's stinger, rumored to inflict a mild venom.

name: Wooden Katana
description: A lightweight training weapon crafted from wood, ideal for beginners.

name: Banjo
description: A finely crafted banjo, its melodies capable of inspiring allies.

name: Icewraith Claymore
description: A greatsword forged from perpetual ice, resonating with a freezing aura. Its chilling touch drains the warmth from all it strikes.

name: Minestrone
description: A hearty soup, rich with vegetables and pasta.

name: Gummy Candy
description: A chewy, fruit-flavored treat. Restores a small amount of HP.

name: Boots of Winter
description: Warm, insulated boots designed for traversing snowy landscapes, offering protection against the cold.

name: Swift Blade
description: A finely balanced one-handed sword, crafted for rapid, precise strikes.

name: Sunken Dagger of Kali
description: A dagger salvaged from the abyssal depths, its blade etched with arcane symbols that whisper of ancient, dark power.

name: Hidden Dagger of Kali
description: A finely balanced dagger rumored to have been used by assassins in service to a forgotten deity.

name: Crown of the Eternal Vagrant
description: A well-worn crown said to be bestowed upon a legendary traveler who never settled, granting keen senses and resilience.

name: Snow Owl Mittens
description: Warm mittens crafted from the down of the mythical snow owl. Imbued with a faint magical chill.

name: Keen Edge
description: A masterfully honed one-handed blade, its edge capable of piercing through the toughest hides.

name: Filthy Trinket
description: A small, tarnished trinket found in a refuse pile. It smells faintly of something unpleasant.

name: Debt's Favor
description: A peculiar ring, said to grant its wearer a portion of power borrowed from the ether, though at a subtle, unspoken cost.

name: Fealty Stone
description: A stone said to pulse with the unwavering essence of true loyalty. Highly prized in the creation of artifacts bound by oath.

name: Operator's Tunic
description: A specialized tunic designed for efficient operation in the field, granting enhanced precision and agility.

name: Crown of Icarus
description: A lightweight crown said to imbue its wearer with the agility of flight, though one must be mindful not to fly too close to the sun.

name: Helm of the Dragon King
description: A helm crafted from the scales and essence of a mighty dragon, once worn by ancient kings to inspire awe and strike fear.

name: Light's End
description: A radiant one-handed sword that banishes shadows. Its holy light empowers divine magic.

name: Bow of the Gorgon Outcast
description: A bow rumored to have once belonged to a shunned Gorgon, its design hinting at both serpentine grace and deadly precision.

name: Utzu Mah Turi
description: A finely crafted blade rumored to hum with ancient, silent power.

name: King's Alibi
description: An ornate ring, said to have been worn by a king who always found a way to escape certain doom.

name: Enigma's Curse
description: A peculiar amulet said to whisper secrets of forgotten lore, granting potent magical insights at a minor cost to physical fortitude and health.

name: Bone Plate Gauntlets
description: Sturdy gauntlets fashioned from hardened bone plates, offering solid protection.

name: B0ne Plate Helm
description: A crude helm crafted from reinforced bone plates. Surprisingly sturdy.

name: Sheepskin Leggings
description: Comfortable leggings crafted from soft sheepskin, offering light protection.

name: Robe of Solitude
description: A simple robe said to enhance the mental fortitude of its wearer, ideal for quiet contemplation.

name: Paltry Bastard Sword
description: A crudely forged, yet surprisingly effective bastard sword for the aspiring adventurer. Its balance is poor.

name: Turtle Helm
description: A durable helmet crafted from a hardened turtle shell.

name: Threads of the Missing Gods
description: A shimmering mantle woven from the faint echoes of forgotten deities, granting a whisper of their ancient wisdom and protection.

name: Death's Gambit
description: A dark blade rumored to offer overwhelming power, but at a hidden cost only the wielder can pay.

name: Parlay of the Shy Priestess
description: A delicate necklace, imbued with the soft-spoken wisdom of a devoted priestess, said to calm even the most heated of disputes.

name: Bloodstained Gladiator Helm
description: A dented and bloodstained helm worn by a veteran gladiator. Its grim appearance belies its protective qualities.

name: Fourth Remorse
description: A blade pulsating with the weight of forgotten vows and profound regret. It whispers forgotten secrets to its wielder.

name: Cow Fat
description: Fat rendered from a cow. Used in various crafting recipes.

name: Duck Fat
description: Rendered duck fat, often used in cooking.

name: Chicken Egg
description: An ordinary chicken egg. Used in various cooking recipes.

name: Duck Egg
description: An egg laid by a common duck. A versatile ingredient in many culinary and alchemical recipes.

name: Pig Fat
description: Fat rendered from a wild boar. A common ingredient in cooking and alchemy.

name: Goose Egg
description: A large, pale egg, surprisingly durable. Prized by culinarians and alchemists alike for its rich contents.

name: Grass Skirt
description: A simple skirt woven from sturdy, dried island grasses. Offers minimal protection.

name: Lost Sweater
description: A well-worn, comfortable sweater that seems to have a story behind its faded colors.

name: Filth of Agamemnon
description: A congealed mass of dark, odorous matter. Though repulsive, it radiates a strange, potent energy, hinting at its legendary origin.

name: Taint's Embrace
description: A ring radiating a subtle, dark aura. It is said to grant its wearer a deeper connection to the forbidden arts, though at a hidden cost.

name: Rune of Cain
description: A dark, blood-red rune, said to thrum with the primal curse of the First Slayer. Grants unnatural strength and precision.

name: Loki's Favor
description: A ring said to be gifted by Loki himself, granting its wearer a touch of his cunning and agility.

name: Raven's Gift
description: A dark, polished ring said to be blessed by a spirit of the night. Enhances one's perception and agility.

name: Blue Garter
description: A garter of deep blue, said to bring forth magical inspiration and nimble steps.

name: Crown of Madness
description: A crown said to twist the wearer's mind, granting unsettling insights at a cost.

name: Dark Robe
description: An ominous robe, said to enhance the forbidden arts of its wearer.

name: simple dagger
description: A basic, unadorned dagger. Suitable for beginners.

name: Green Hat
description: A simple, forest-green hat. Provides minor protection for adventurers.

name: Yellow Cape
description: A simple cape, dyed a vibrant yellow, favored by newer adventurers.

name: Crimson Robe
description: A vibrant red robe, favored by mages for its protective qualities and striking appearance.

name: Glass Ring
description: A delicate ring crafted from polished glass, granting a slight boost to mental clarity.

name: Brass Ring
description: A simple ring made of brass. Offers a minor defensive boost.

name: Helm of the Forgotten Kingdom
description: A sturdy helm, once worn by a knight of a long-lost empire, imbued with the tenacity of ancient heroes.

name: Gloves of the Faithful
description: Gloves worn by devout magic users, imbuing them with spiritual strength.

name: White Gloves
description: Simple white gloves favored by practitioners of healing and protective magic.

name: Wolf Skin Gaiters
description: Gaiters crafted from the durable hide of a fierce wolf, offering modest protection.

name: Stone of the Gentle Plague
description: A stone pulsing with a faint, sickly green light, said to ward off contagion.

name: Kitchen Knife
description: A common household knife, surprisingly sharp. Not ideal for combat, but better than nothing.

name: Pink Apron
description: A frilly pink apron, beloved by chefs and charming adventurers alike.

name: Shepherd's Staff
description: A rustic staff, carved from ancient wood, imbued with the spirit of the wilds.

name: Tin Ore
description: A common, soft metallic ore often used in alloys.

name: Gold Ore
description: A chunk of raw gold, sought after by goldsmiths and jewelcrafters.

name: Copper Ore
description: A reddish-brown ore.

name: Last Regret
description: A blade said to be forged from the tears of a vanquished hero, imbued with their final, lingering regret.

name: Soul of Jordan
description: An earring pulsing with the indomitable spirit of the legendary hero, Jordan. Its wearer feels a surge of their own inherent potential.

name: Simple Bow
description: A crudely made bow, suitable for beginners.

name: Sabre
description: A light and well-balanced single-edged sword, popular among new adventurers.

name: Qi Tornado
description: A pair of weighted handguards imbued with tempestuous energies, allowing the wearer to strike with the force of a whirlwind.

name: Heavy Claws
description: A pair of weighted metal claws designed for delivering powerful, crushing blows.

name: Titanium Claws
description: Claws forged from lightweight yet incredibly durable titanium, granting speed and defense.

name: Simple Robe
description: A basic, unadorned robe commonly worn by fledgling mages.
